recommendations.body: `cmd_direct_run()` in `plan_tool/cli/direct_cmd.py` (step 5 "Add the `direct-run` verb that chains create, detail, run `--commit`, and the reconcile-code loop") hard-codes `yes=True` on the reconcile namespace, which `plan_tool/cli/reconcile.py:_cmd_run_reconcile` feeds into `WalkState(yes_to_all=args.yes)`, so every reconcile-code finding auto-applies its inline code edit with no per-finding confirmation even when the operator ran `direct-run` without `-y`. The detail lists `yes` as a cross-cutting flag copied through unchanged and names only `step` and `dry_run` as the reconcile overrides; `register()`'s own `-y` help likewise claims only the completeness-apply and run stages "already run non-interactive". Sibling `cmd_direct_jira` sets no such override
recommendations.suggested_action: drop the `yes=True` override from the reconcile `_stage_namespace(...)` call in `cmd_direct_run()` so `yes` copies from the input args

The detail's run-override list omits `yes`, and `cmd_run --all` already implies `-y` for the per-step paths, so the override buys nothing and only suppresses the missing-detail confirmation
recommendations.suggested_action: drop the `yes=True` override from the run `_stage_namespace(...)` call in `cmd_direct_run()`
